name: MAG240M: Large-Scale Heterogeneous Academic Graph
description: MAG240M is a massive heterogeneous academic graph benchmark extracted from the Microsoft Academic Graph (MAG) as part of the OGB-LSC initiative. It consists of 244,160,499 nodes (121.7M papers, 122.4M authors, 25.7K institutions) and 1,728,364,232 directed edges representing paper-cites-paper, author-writes-paper, and author-affiliated-with-institution relations. Each paper features a 768-dimensional RoBERTa embedding of its title and abstract. The task is to predict the primary arXiv subject category of target papers across 153 classes with a temporal split.
